events.detail: 00-spec.yaml declares risk: medium; quorum analyze risk-score calculated low because the change touches only 2 files, neither of which matches a sensitive path. The human's declared risk WINS and 00-spec.yaml was not modified. The divergence is real but the declared level is the defensible one: the file count is small, yet the harness asserts a QA gate whose failure modes are silent (see the GCRA per-conversation keying risk), so a scorer that only counts files understates the design risk.

codebase-memory-mcp index_status for project home-gary-dev-hexcell reported status ready with git.head_sha 90412a3eaa035a95ff80dcb51b5400eb22a70e63, matching git rev-parse HEAD. The graph was fresh; every load-bearing fact was nonetheless confirmed by direct reads of the real files.

The HSME advisory read hook failed: search-fuzzy returned INTERNAL_ERROR 'failed to open database: bootstrap open db: failed to set pragma: unable to open database file: no such file or directory'. This is the identical failure recorded for HEX-046. Per the skill's graceful-degradation path the phase proceeded without semantic context, and the failure is reported rather than silently dropped.

The orchestrator bundle proposed measuring per-event latency as wall time captured around procesar_evento. Motor::procesar_evento is PRIVATE (crates/hexcell/src/motor.rs:247) and cannot be called from crates/hexcell/tests/. The bundle also offered log parsing as a fallback source for discard counts; that is likewise impossible, because crates/hexcell/src/registro.rs records into its thread-local capture only under #[cfg(test)] and exposes the capture as `pub(crate) mod pruebas`, neither of which applies when the lib is linked by an integration test. Both options were rejected. Latency is measured with a harness-local ProcesadorDeMensajes wrapper; discard counts come from the already-public metricas::tomar_instantanea.

Harness placement: a new #[ignore]d #[tokio::test] at crates/hexcell/tests/carga.rs, run with `cargo test --workspace -- --ignored carga_del_canal --nocapture`. Chosen over an example, a bin, or a scripts/laboratorio/ shell script because crates/hexcell/tests/rss_linea_base.rs is the repository's ONLY existing #[ignore] test, is the only other /proc VmRSS measurement, uses that exact invocation shape, and is already documented in docs/STATUS.md lines 318-324; scripts/laboratorio/ holds sh harnesses that drive real external processes (sidecar, QR pairing), which this in-process port test is not. No [[example]] or [[bin]] section exists in any crate manifest, so either would have required a Cargo.toml edit this task forbids. Processor: ProcesadorDeEco wrapped for timing, isolating ADMISSION (the criterion's subject) from budget and provider noise. Discard source: metricas::tomar_instantanea returning InstantaneaDeMetricas public fields, exact and never log-parsed. GCRA: ConfiguracionGcra::nueva(0.5, 9) with all 100 events on ONE conversation key, admitting tolerancia_rafaga + 1 = 10 and discarding ~90 deterministically, since the 2 s emission interval leaks nothing during a millisecond-scale drain. RSS: /proc/self/status VmRSS read before injection and after the drain, asserted HARD at <= 15 % of the run's own baseline (the stage criterion at docs/plan/fase-a-4-admision-presupuesto.md lines 131-134 is worded as a QA bound, so a bound is what is asserted), with both absolute kB values printed for the operator.

quorum analyze contract-check simulated the planned 2-file, ~320-line change against 02-contract.yaml and returned ok:true with no violations (not_checked: forbid.behaviors). Guard applied per the hex-044/hex-045/hex-046 precedent, where an execute attempt was BLOCKED for a file the instructions required but touch omitted.

quorum analyze acceptance-coverage returned status pass with zero gaps after explicit `covers` links were added to the blueprint test_scenarios; AC-1, AC-2 and AC-3 are each covered by at least one scenario. The two unnumbered acceptance bullets are legacy_untracked by design: they map to verify.commands, not to test scenarios.

The scoped English-leak grep of verify.commands was executed against the current tree before being written into the contract. All 21 candidate words returned 0 hits on docs/STATUS.md, so no pre-existing prose can trip the gate. This pre-empts the HEX-046 failure mode, where a first candidate list including 'metrics' failed on pre-existing prose at docs/STATUS.md:507. crates/hexcell/tests/carga.rs does not exist yet and will be authored in Spanish.

The load-test harness is deliberately EXCLUDED from verify.commands. verify only proves the harness compiles and that the fast suite still passes; the on-demand run `cargo test --workspace -- --ignored carga_del_canal --nocapture` IS the acceptance evidence for AC-1..AC-3. This is stated in the contract goal so a later reviewer does not report the absence as a coverage gap. Making the heavy job a blocking CI gate is an explicit spec non-goal.
